title: docs: reformat random SETUP.md Overview section to canonical format
author: app/claude
body:
## Summary

- Removes the extra introductory sentence ("The Random plugin needs no API key or external service — it generates all values locally.") that appeared before `**What it does:**`, which isn't present in other plugin SETUP.md files
- Reformats `**What it does:**` from inline prose into a bullet list on the lines following the label
- Reformats `**Prerequisites:**` from inline prose into a bullet list on the lines following the label
- Matches the pattern used by `countdown/docs/SETUP.md` and `date_time/docs/SETUP.md`

## What I changed

Single file: `plugins/random/docs/SETUP.md` — Overview section only. No logic, no tests, no other files touched.

## Confidence

High. This is a straightforward format alignment — the content itself is preserved, only the structure changes to match the canonical SETUP.md pattern described in CLAUDE.md and illustrated by the other shipped plugins.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Bullet list content accurately reflects what the plugin does
- [ ] Formatting matches `countdown/docs/SETUP.md` Overview section

Closes #1127

**Verdict:** one nit -- voice is good, facts check out.

The Overview restructuring (prose to bullets) is a clear improvement for scannability, and every bullet maps accurately to the manifest variables.

**Minor note (not in the diff):** The PR drops the phrase "it generates all values locally" from the original Overview. The no-API-key half is preserved, but that phrase is useful user-facing context (no network calls, works offline, privacy-friendly). Consider restoring it as a closing sentence in the Overview:

> No network calls are made; all values are generated locally.

Inline suggestion below for the Prerequisites formatting.
